# Prometheus AI Trading Bot

> Prometheus AI is a non-custodial, automated cryptocurrency trading bot that monitors and trades crypto markets 24/7 on the user's own exchange account. Funds never leave the user's exchange — the bot connects with a trade-only API key (withdrawals disabled). It is sold as a one-time purchase (lifetime access) for $267, with a free live-demo trial available before buying.

Official website: https://www.prometheusai.tech/
Free trial / live demo: https://prometheus-bot.fly.dev/
Support: support@prometheusai.tech (24/7 live chat also available on the site)

## Key facts

- Non-custodial: the bot trades on the user's own exchange via a trade-only API key; it can place trades but can never withdraw funds.
- Supported exchanges: Binance, Binance.US, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin, Bitget, Kraken, Coinbase (spot & futures).
- Built-in strategy: EMA 9/21 crossover with a 100-EMA trend filter, plus stop-loss/take-profit on every trade and risk guardrails (daily-loss limit, max-drawdown guard).
- Two-way Telegram control: /status, /pnl, /positions, /pause, /resume, /closeall.
- Trading involves risk; no returns are guaranteed. Past performance does not indicate future results.
